Legal

Privacy Policy

Last updated: July 6, 2026

1. Who we are

IMAI Labs Inc. (“IMAI”, “we”, “us”) operates the InfluencerMarketing.ai website and platform. This policy explains how we handle personal data as a controller for our website and as a processor for customer campaign data.

2. Data we collect

  • Account data — name, work email, company, billing details.
  • Usage data — pages visited, features used, device and browser information.
  • Creator data — publicly available profile and engagement statistics that power discovery and vetting.
  • Campaign data — content, briefs and payment records our customers manage in the platform.

3. How we use data

We use personal data to provide and secure the Service, process payments, respond to support requests, send service communications, and — with consent where required — product updates and marketing. We do not sell personal data.

4. Legal bases

Where GDPR applies, we process data on the bases of contract performance, legitimate interests (such as securing and improving the Service), consent, and legal obligations.

5. Sharing

We share data with service providers (hosting, payments, analytics) under data-processing agreements, with payment networks to execute creator payouts, and where required by law. Creator profile data shown in the platform is compiled from public sources.

6. International transfers & retention

Data may be processed in other countries under appropriate safeguards such as Standard Contractual Clauses. We retain personal data for as long as an account is active and as required for legal and accounting purposes, then delete or anonymise it.

7. Your rights

Depending on your location you may request access, correction, deletion, portability or restriction of your personal data, and you may object to certain processing. Contact hello@influencermarketing.ai to exercise these rights; you may also lodge a complaint with your supervisory authority.

8. Contact

Privacy questions and requests: hello@influencermarketing.ai.
